title: Sandbox: grant ioctl (termios tcgetattr/tcsetattr) under a terminal-control effect so a verified editor runs CONFINED (today the seccomp write set lacks ioctl -> sandboxed editor SIGSYS; runs only --no-sandbox)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Plan: a dedicated Effect::Term atom + fx term -> TERM_SYSCALLS={ioctl:16}; editor raw_mode declares fx term; the editor then runs FULLY sandboxed (grounded: ioctl was the only missing syscall). Filed #132 for impl.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: EPIC COMPLETE + critic-clean (c369425). The verified editor now runs CONFINED: a dedicated Effect::Term terminal-control effect (fx term -> ioctl) so forge build editor.th --entry run (NO --no-sandbox) compiles + runs under seccomp, exit 0 (raw mode + edit + Ctrl-S save), not SIGSYS. Required widening the Verus-proved effect-subsumption bitset u8->u16 + re-deriving the bit_vector proofs (the principled extensible-effect path, since REQ-7 requires term to be subsumption-checked). Critic NO DIVERGENCE. The --no-sandbox caveat in the docs is now obsolete (separate doc pass).
